questions.prompt: How many total kilograms of raw carrots are produced by all commercial vegetable farms across Germany in a single year?
reasoning: Germany has a population of about 84 million people who consume root vegetables regularly.
Annual per capita consumption of carrots in central Europe is roughly 7 kilograms.
Total national consumption equals 84 million people multiplied by 7 kilograms, yielding approximately 600,000,000 kilograms.

questions.prompt: How many total individual wooden toothpicks are manufactured by all toothpick factories operating in Sweden in a single year?
reasoning: Sweden has a population of around 10 million people.
Restaurants, households, and catering services use a modest average of 5 toothpicks per person per year.
Multiplying 10 million people by 5 toothpicks yields roughly 50 million, adjusted down slightly for local production share to 45 million.

questions.prompt: How many total litres of fuel are consumed by all commercial passenger buses operating in urban transit networks across France in a single year?
reasoning: France has a fleet of roughly 50,000 urban and regional public transit buses.
Each bus travels an average of 40,000 kilometres per year on scheduled routes.
With a typical fuel efficiency of about 35 litres per 100 kilometres, 40,000 kilometres consumes 14,000 litres per bus.
Multiplying 50,000 buses by 14,000 litres gives a total annual consumption of 700 million litres.
